This episode is brought to you by MU Health Care, Hen House and Coleman Appliance.

item.title: US must intensify vaccination effort to regain measles-free status lost after 26 years | Jefferson City News-Tribune
item.description: WASHINGTON/CHICAGO -- Public health experts say the US must drive vaccinations and disease surveillance in order to regain the hard-won measles-free status it held for 26 years that a Trump administration official said on Monday had been revoked.
